messages:
Maria: Morning team — quick standup. What I did: landed kernel patch to add a soft guard on batch slot allocation (PR #4827), added a small benchmark harness for warmup path. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rt/pull/4827
Keenan: Nice. Blocker: nightly bench flaked on staging — `bench_runner` OOM at seq_len=2048 during microburst test. saw it twice in a row.
Maria: I reproduced the OOM locally with the same seed, looks like batcher can create an oversized slot when prefetch spikes. Adding a max-slot-safety check now. Will push a fix this morning.
Olga: On canary now — rolling to 3 nodes with reduced prefetch. Deploy-bot: canary deploy for rt-kernel v0.23.1 -> passed healthchecks 3/3.
Sam: Today's plan: run a full perf sweep after Maria's fix, then exercise slot-steal scenarios with microburst flag on three instance types.
Keenan: Quick ask — can someone review my CR? `runtime/batcher/slot_align.go` (PR 4830). It's a small refactor + one extra metric.
Maria: @Olga can you eyeball the KV eviction heuristics diff in my other PR? I'm trying to avoid thrashing when kv_hit_rate oscillates.
Olga: Will review by EOD. FYI SRE flagged a perf spike at 03:10am — p50 latency up ~12% for 6m. Dev-bot: perf-alert #kernel-spike created (alert id 9054).
Sam: I rolled back the aggressive prefetch in staging to isolate cause; smoke tests are green so far.
Keenan: Observed trace shows kv_get hit rate dropped from 82% -> 65% in the window. Looks correlated with model-version salted keys.
Maria: Hypothesis: cache keys are being salted by model artifact version; I'll add normalization to strip model version suffix before caching and run canary. If that fixes hit-rate we'll add a migration plan.
Olga: If normalization works we should also consider a short migration script to rebuild hot prefixes. Otherwise fallback to local memoization for 48h.
Sam: Running smokebench now: `./bench_tool --profile kernel --iters 50 --seq 512 --tag morning-sweep` — will post results in ~20m.
Keenan: Great, ping me when done, I'll run trace analysis. :+1:
Maria: No other blockers from my side after I push the safety guard.
Olga: Small FYI — SRE asked to retain kernel perf logs for 7d; Ryan do we have budget for extended retention?
Ryan: Confirmed — we can extend `/perf/kernel` retention to 7d for the next week. I've opened infra ticket INF-712 to track.
Sam: Thanks Ryan. I'll attach the smokebench output to INF-712 after the run.
Deploy-bot: Canary -> stable rollout queued (wait for manual confirm after benchmark).
Maria: Thanks all — will ping when fix is pushed and canary results are in.
Keenan: I'll leave a review queue note on PR 4830.
Olga: Reviewing Maria's KV diff now.
Dev-bot: Reminder: weekly perf retro tomorrow 10:30am.
Maria: End of standup — no new blockers.
